correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive engines independently give exactly 342 ternary square-free words of length 13. Direct deletion tests leave exactly 30 irreducibly square-free words. Two least-square-period scans agree after every one of the 330 interior deletions. The radius histogram is exactly 18 at 3 and 12 at 6. Symmetry recomputation gives three orbits of sizes 12, 6, and 12, and the radius-6 orbit has exactly one deletion per word whose least square period is 6.

value.rationale: Length 13 is the first length after the final forbidden length 12 in Harju's exact spectrum, and the source already isolates only three symmetry classes there. The least period of the deletion-created square directly measures how irreducibility is certified. The exact split shows that two classes are locally fragile while one class has a deletion whose certificate is necessarily the entire post-deletion word, a structural distinction not visible from the known class count alone.
